title: Brahmi Sarbat
description: Brahmi Sarbat is a highly beneficial brain-toning syrup prepared from the extracts of the memory-enhancing herb Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri). This classical formulation sharpens memory. Enhances concentration. Reduces mental exhaustion. Helps school-going children and professionals manage stress.
dosage: 15–25 ml mixed in a glass of warm or cold milk, preferably in the morning
